title: Massless flavor-symmetric Standard Model susceptibility benchmark
assumptions: electroweak-symmetric, relativistic and massless plasma benchmark
three generations combined in a flavor-symmetric sector
all Standard Model Yukawa interactions treated as equilibrated
gauge interactions equalize components inside each multiplet
no right-handed neutrinos or additional fields
external source couples to B+L with mu_S = dot(Theta)/f_Theta
limitations: thermal masses and Higgs expectation value near the electroweak crossover are omitted
lepton flavor differences and partial equilibration are omitted
running alpha_W and lattice-rate uncertainties are omitted in the central web curve
the basis-independent mapping from the Theta operator to the source vector is not derived
Theta backreaction, energy density, washout and isocurvature are not included
